crossrefs.text: Abishai said to David, “Today God has delivered your enemy into your hand. Now, therefore, please let me thrust the spear through him into the ground with one stroke. I will not need to strike him twice!”
But the LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORDʼs anointed. Instead, take the spear and water jug by his head, and let us go.”
May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the Lorddelivered you into my hand today, but I would not extend my hand against the LORDʼs anointed.

Behold, this day you have seen with your own eyes that the LORD delivered you into my hand in the cave. I was told to kill you, but I spared you and said, ‘I will not lift my hand against my lord, since he is the LORDʼs anointed.’

After David had numbered the troops, his conscience was stricken and he said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, O LORD, I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.”
After Ehud was gone, Eglonʼs servants came in and found the doors of the upper room locked. “He must be relieving himself in the cool room,” they said.

He chose for himself three thousand men of Israel: Two thousand were with Saul at Michmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. And the rest of the troops he sent away, each to his own home.
When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.”

Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the Lordjudge between you and me.”
Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
However, if I were you, I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him—
Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

crossrefs.text: Then Saul replied, “I have sinned. Come back, David my son. I will never harm you again, because today you considered my life precious. I have played the fool and have committed a grave error!”
But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.”
saying, “Do not be afraid, for my father Saul will never lay a hand on you. And you will be king over Israel, and I will be your second-in-command. Even my father Saul knows this is true.”
And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.
Then Saul recognized Davidʼs voice and asked, “Is that your voice, David my son?” “It is my voice, my lord and king,” David said.
Then Laban declared, “This mound is a witness between you and me this day.” Therefore the place was called Galeed.
May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
